the locust AL is not simply a linear transformation of the ORN code, and that the AL’s architecture is critical to this transformation.

the locust olfactory network can generate a highly diverse and dynamic population of active neurons in response to odors, and that this population of active neurons is likely to encode odors in a more complex manner than a direct feed-forward scheme.
